goal: Qualify GWC Universal V2 by safe forward progress. Do not search for, manufacture, inject, or require an incident that has not occurred. If a genuine runtime defect is observed during qualification, enter bounded self-remediation and then continue.

statements: không cố tạo tìm incident chưa xảy ra. Cần đi tiếp an toàn, không phải blocking.
cần update các statement gây cản trở gwc v2 release

children.action: Reconcile exact source, current checkpoint, successor plan and profile; classify historical original DWO NOT_REPRODUCED as non-blocking evidence.
Start a clean isolated runtime activation and prove exact source/profile/module/instruction identity.
Execute the complete mandatory Q0 matrix using safe deterministic scenarios. Continue on PASS. Enter self-remediation only if a genuine current runtime defect is observed.
Run broader regression, exact readback and UR.G5 target validation against the exact qualified identity.

Issue L3 certification using genuine-defect replay evidence when a real defect occurred, otherwise SAFE_FORWARD_NO_INCIDENT provenance; prepare UR.G6 human acceptance without implying effect authority.

acceptance_criteria: No qualification step searches for or manufactures a runtime incident solely to obtain RED/replay evidence.
No genuine current defect remains unresolved.
Exact candidate, loaded source, profile and module/instruction identities are bound and verified.
Mandatory Q0 matrix is complete with observed evidence and broader regression PASS.
If a genuine defect occurred, its remediation has exact replay/readback and forward-progress evidence.
If no genuine defect occurred, certification uses SAFE_FORWARD_NO_INCIDENT / NO_ACTIVE_RUNTIME_DEFECT provenance with no fabricated failure state.
UR.G5 validates the exact qualified target identity.
UR.G6 acceptance remains a separate Human NHAT decision and grants no merge/deploy/production authority.
